Owls came in with a 3% below average attack and a league-average defense (4-2, 81.8 scored and 75.2 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 191 and 191 games of evidence. Projected to score 71.5, they scored 68 (−3.5 points, 5% under); projected to allow 76.7, they allowed 67 (−9.7 points, 13% under).

The bigger miss was Flames' scoring (-9.7 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.
